summary:
The Earth Information Jukebox 

I chose to visualize the temperature of the ocean using NASA's data at: https://worldview.earthdata.nasa.gov/

The Tones of the Ocean app - a way to turn sea surface temperature imagery into sound. 

Two functions: 
1) Move around on the map at a fixed date and one can for instance investigate changes around the world and 
2) stay at a fixed location and experience the changes throughout one year.
details: The webpage visualize/Sonification the ocean temperature so it is possible to see the changing temperature around the world and also at a fixed location, the changes during a year.
